families.label: Idle + fidgets
families.current: Stable 73.8 px silhouette; fidgets share the calibrated Blender sheet.
families.target: Preserve identity, foot plant and quiet entry/exit without restarting the loop.

families.label: UAL Jog loop
families.current: Stable 75.4 px median with 0.5 live-px baseline range.
families.target: Keep UAL Jog authoritative at every grounded movement speed and preserve stride phase.

families.label: Jog start bridge
families.current: Two-frame planted bridge from Blender idle into UAL Jog.
families.target: Start immediately, preserve facing and enter the nearest legal Jog phase.

families.label: Jog stop bridge
families.current: Fourteen phase variants stop into Blender idle.
families.target: Plant the active foot and settle without a size, anchor or one-frame Jog flash.

families.label: Immediate turn + pivot
families.current: Facing flips immediately while locomotion phase remains active.
families.target: Keep zero input delay while preventing mirrored-foot pops and root recoil.

families.label: Stationary SIDE dig
families.current: 109 px Jab/Cross can pull the full sprite 16.62 px toward the tile.
families.target: Body-lock the player, keep feet planted and let impact presentation own the final reach.

families.label: Moving SIDE dig
families.current: Phase-aware 123 px Jog composite with body stand-off and disabled visual alignment.
families.target: Retain the approved run-punch language without foot hover, clipping or phase loss.

families.label: Stationary Quickslash
families.current: Shares the stationary Jab contact pull and oversized Jab recovery bridge.
families.target: Keep Q responsive while removing the release skate and one-frame size flash.

families.label: Moving Quickslash
families.current: Sixteen-frame phase-aware Jog attack with body-locked contact.
families.target: Preserve exact Jog phase, facing and contact while held Q repeats.

families.label: Stationary UP dig
families.current: 73.4 px median but compresses to 62.2 px during anticipation.
families.target: Keep the planted lower body and readable upward strike without apparent shrink.

families.label: Moving UP-SIDE dig
families.current: Current production can translate 22.64 px and compress to 62.5 px.
families.target: Use exact Jog lower phase, refined UP torso and zero sprite translation.

families.label: Stationary DOWN dig
families.current: Ground-strike source reaches 51.5 px and can sink 15.04 px into the floor.
families.target: Use the normalized dedicated Blender DOWN action with zero ground intrusion.

families.label: Moving DOWN-SIDE dig
families.current: Current production can translate 22.64 px and overlap the target tile.
families.target: Use Jog lower ownership, dedicated DOWN upper action and zero tile intrusion.

families.label: Thunder charge + slam
families.current: Charge is stable; the ground-strike contact compresses to roughly 52 px.
families.target: Keep the power crouch intentional while preserving body scale, ground plane and impact authority.

families.label: Flight hover + travel
families.current: Approved prone silhouette is approximately 86 by 28 live pixels.
families.target: Preserve visible center, bank continuity and stable velocity-linked cadence.

families.label: Flight release + fall
families.current: Continuous Flight cuts from the prone 86 by 28 shape to an upright 31 by 75 fall.
families.target: Author a short responsive roll-to-fall bridge without delaying Flight cancellation.

families.label: Soft + hard landing
families.current: Current generated final frame reaches 84.6 px before returning to 73.8–75.4 px.
families.target: Retain authored compression but finish on the same apparent scale and destination phase.

families.label: Wall brace + push
families.current: Sustained wall loop is only about 59 px versus the 74–75 px standing body.
families.target: Maintain a planted full-size brace with smooth entry, loop and phase-aware release.

families.label: Hit + death reactions
families.current: Hit reaction is stable near 75 px; death intentionally changes to a horizontal silhouette.
families.target: Keep impact readability while preventing root displacement during interruption and cleanup.

families.label: Teleport + spawn arrival
families.current: Authored roll ranges from 35.8–74.9 px with about 40.5 px lower-root travel.
families.target: Preserve the roll language while landing on the exact gameplay root and idle scale.

lenses.label: Canonical visible height
lenses.instruction: Measure {label} in live pixels and keep every upright handoff inside its authored body-size band.
lenses.pass: Unintentional handoff delta is at most 2 live px.

lenses.label: Source display calibration
lenses.instruction: Resolve {label} source size from the live profile instead of duplicating a guessed 101, 109 or 123 px value.
lenses.pass: Generated and runtime source presentation values are identical.

lenses.label: Foot baseline
lenses.instruction: Lock the grounded pixels of {label} to the canonical source ground line before packing.
lenses.pass: Grounded baseline range is at most 1 source px.

lenses.label: Horizontal root anchor
lenses.instruction: Normalize the lower-body weighted root of {label} without suppressing intentional upper-body reach.
lenses.pass: Unexplained root travel is at most 2 live px.

lenses.label: Runtime origin parity
lenses.instruction: Keep {label} sheet origin and generated pivot metadata on the same canonical anchor.
lenses.pass: Profile, manifest and packed atlas origin values match exactly.

lenses.label: Whole-sprite offset removal
lenses.instruction: Prevent {label} contact correction from translating the visual independently of the movement body.
lenses.pass: Moving actions use 0 px; stationary exceptions require explicit visual approval.

lenses.label: Opaque tile intrusion
lenses.instruction: Measure {label} opaque pixels against every contacted tile face at the authored impact frame.
lenses.pass: No body pixels enter a solid tile; approved hand/FX contact is separately classified.

lenses.label: Tile-face clearance
lenses.instruction: Give {label} a stable visible clearance envelope and let the impact mark bridge the final gap.
lenses.pass: Clearance stays inside the family-specific 1–8 px envelope.

lenses.label: Collider ownership
lenses.instruction: Keep the 31 by 75 gameplay body authoritative throughout {label}, including contact and release.
lenses.pass: No unexplained separation between collider root and planted visual root.

lenses.label: Foot plant continuity
lenses.instruction: Track the active support foot through {label} entry, contact and exit rather than matching only the frame bottom.
lenses.pass: The planted foot moves at most 1 live px during a plant interval.

lenses.label: Entry phase matching
lenses.instruction: Start {label} from the closest legal outgoing locomotion phase without restarting at frame zero.
lenses.pass: Nearest-phase error is at most 1 frame for frequent actions.

lenses.label: Exit phase matching
lenses.instruction: Resume Idle, Jog or Fall from {label} using the destination phase implied by the final planted pose.
lenses.pass: No one-frame destination flash and at most 1 frame phase error.

lenses.label: Facing and flip continuity
lenses.instruction: Apply {label} facing immediately while retaining the correct authored source orientation and support foot.
lenses.pass: Facing latency is 0 frames and the animation does not restart unnecessarily.

lenses.label: Entry timing
lenses.instruction: Keep {label} anticipation readable without delaying admission, movement response or damage timing.
lenses.pass: Input and facing delay remain 0 frames.

lenses.label: Contact timing
lenses.instruction: Bind {label} gameplay contact, visual pose, impact FX and sound to one authored sequence index.
lenses.pass: All contact consumers resolve on the same frame.

lenses.label: Release and cancel timing
lenses.instruction: Release {label} immediately when its controlling input or target ends, then settle visually without lockout.
lenses.pass: Gameplay release is immediate; visual settling never blocks input.

lenses.label: Cadence and time scale
lenses.instruction: Scale {label} playback from authored cadence and real displacement without skipping the contact pose.
lenses.pass: Contact is never skipped and loop displacement error stays below 5 percent.

lenses.label: Upper/lower body ownership
lenses.instruction: Assign {label} locomotion to the lower body and action intent to the upper body wherever movement continues.
lenses.pass: No frame has two systems moving the same body region.

lenses.label: Composite seam quality
lenses.instruction: Feather every {label} torso/lower-body composite around a pelvis-derived seam and inspect both facings.
lenses.pass: No visible cut, duplicate limb or alpha hole at review scale.

lenses.label: Pose arc and silhouette
lenses.instruction: Clarify {label} anticipation, contact and recoil silhouettes while preserving the character's apparent mass.
lenses.pass: Three key poses remain distinguishable at gameplay zoom.

lenses.label: Impact FX anchoring
lenses.instruction: Anchor {label} impact art to the authoritative tile or world contact rather than the drifting sprite.
lenses.pass: Impact error is at most 1 live px at contact.

lenses.label: Audio and haptic sync
lenses.instruction: Synchronize any {label} sound, shake and haptic accent with the same authored contact or plant event.
lenses.pass: Feedback error remains below one rendered frame.

lenses.label: Single transition owner
lenses.instruction: Give {label} scale, anchor, phase and completion to one transition owner so procedural and authored motion cannot stack.
lenses.pass: Exactly one presentation owner writes each transform channel.

lenses.label: Atlas and residency cost
lenses.instruction: Measure {label} decoded texture cost, reuse shared frames and defer rare families without first-use hitching.
lenses.pass: Resident cost is justified by use frequency and fits the animation texture budget.

lenses.label: Automated regression gate
lenses.instruction: Add a deterministic {label} contract covering size, anchor, contact, phase, file ownership and rollback.
lenses.pass: Every promoted path has numeric and isolation assertions.

scenarios.label: Stationary SIDE / Q release
scenarios.before: The visual is pulled 16.62 px toward the tile, then the first settle frame grows from roughly 72 to 81 px while the offset releases.
scenarios.after: The collider and sprite stay body-locked; impact owns the reach and the settle is rebuilt from the live 109 px action calibration.

scenarios.label: Landing finish
scenarios.before: The generated hard landing ends around 84.6 px, then drops to the 73.8–75.4 px Idle/Jog family.
scenarios.after: The same authored landing frames use their real 109 px source calibration and finish on the canonical grounded scale.

scenarios.label: Wall brace + push
scenarios.before: The two-frame brace falls into a roughly 59 px wall loop, then release jumps directly back toward 74 px.
scenarios.after: A planted full-height brace retains the authored pushing upper body with a feathered pelvis stretch and three-frame entry/exit.
